verses.ar: بَعْدَ هَذَا فَتَحَ أَيُّوبُ فَاهُ وَسَبَّ يَوْمَهُ،
verses.kjv: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
verses.web: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

verses.ar: وَأَخَذَ أَيُّوبُ يَتَكَلَّمُ فَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: And Job spake, and said,
verses.web: Job answered:

verses.ar: «لَيْتَهُ هَلَكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِي وُلِدْتُ فِيهِ، وَٱللَّيْلُ ٱلَّذِي قَالَ: قَدْ حُبِلَ بِرَجُلٍ.
verses.kjv: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night [in which] it was said, There is a man child conceived.
verses.web: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

verses.ar: لِيَكُنْ ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ظَلَامًا. لَا يَعْتَنِ بِهِ ٱللهُ مِنْ فَوْقُ، وَلَا يُشْرِقْ عَلَيْهِ نَهَارٌ.
verses.kjv: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
verses.web: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

verses.ar: لِيَمْلِكْهُ ٱلظَّلَامُ وَظِلُّ ٱلْمَوْتِ. لِيَحُلَّ عَلَيْهِ سَحَابٌ. لِتَرْعَبْهُ كَاسِفَاتُ ٱلنَّهَارِ.
verses.kjv: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
verses.web: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ذَلِكَ ٱللَّيْلُ فَلْيُمْسِكْهُ ٱلدُّجَى، وَلَا يَفْرَحْ بَيْنَ أَيَّامِ ٱلسَّنَةِ، وَلَا يَدْخُلَنَّ فِي عَدَدِ ٱلشُّهُورِ.
verses.kjv: As [for] that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.web: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

verses.ar: هُوَذَا ذَلِكَ ٱللَّيْلُ لِيَكُنْ عَاقِرًا، لَا يُسْمَعْ فِيهِ هُتَافٌ.
verses.kjv: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.web: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

verses.ar: لِيَلْعَنْهُ لَاعِنُو ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمُسْتَعِدُّونَ لِإِيقَاظِ ٱلتِّنِّينِ.
verses.kjv: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.
verses.web: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

verses.ar: لِتُظْلِمْ نُجُومُ عِشَائِهِ. لِيَنْتَظِرِ ٱلنُّورَ وَلَا يَكُنْ، وَلَا يَرَ هُدُبَ ٱلصُّبْحِ،
verses.kjv: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but [have] none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:
verses.web: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُغْلِقْ أَبْوَابَ بَطْنِ أُمِّي، وَلَمْ يَسْتُرِ ٱلشَّقَاوَةَ عَنْ عَيْنَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Because it shut not up the doors of my [mother’s] womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
verses.web: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

verses.ar: لِمَ لَمْ أَمُتْ مِنَ ٱلرَّحِمِ؟ عِنْدَمَا خَرَجْتُ مِنَ ٱلْبَطْنِ، لِمَ لَمْ أُسْلِمِ ٱلرُّوحَ؟
verses.kjv: Why died I not from the womb? [why] did I [not] give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
verses.web: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا أَعَانَتْنِي ٱلرُّكَبُ، وَلِمَ ٱلثُّدِيُّ حَتَّى أَرْضَعَ؟
verses.kjv: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
verses.web: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي قَدْ كُنْتُ ٱلْآنَ مُضْطَجِعًا سَاكِنًا. حِينَئِذٍ كُنْتُ نِمْتُ مُسْتَرِيحًا
verses.kjv: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
verses.web: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

verses.ar: مَعَ مُلُوكٍ وَمُشِيرِي ٱلْأَرْضِ، ٱلَّذِينَ بَنَوْا أَهْرَامًا لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ،
verses.kjv: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;
verses.web: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

verses.ar: أَوْ مَعَ رُؤَسَاءَ لَهُمْ ذَهَبٌ، ٱلْمَالِئِينَ بُيُوتَهُمْ فِضَّةً،
verses.kjv: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
verses.web: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

verses.ar: أَوْ كَسِقْطٍ مَطْمُورٍ فَلَمْ أَكُنْ، كَأَجِنَّةٍ لَمْ يَرَوْا نُورًا.
verses.kjv: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants [which] never saw light.
verses.web: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

verses.ar: هُنَاكَ يَكُفُّ ٱلْمُنَافِقُونَ عَنِ ٱلشَّغْبِ، وَهُنَاكَ يَسْتَرِيحُ ٱلْمُتْعَبُونَ.
verses.kjv: There the wicked cease [from] troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
verses.web: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

verses.ar: ٱلْأَسْرَى يَطْمَئِنُّونَ جَمِيعًا، لَا يَسْمَعُونَ صَوْتَ ٱلْمُسَخِّرِ.
verses.kjv: [There] the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
verses.web: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

verses.ar: ٱلصَّغِيرُ كَمَا ٱلْكَبِيرُ هُنَاكَ، وَٱلْعَبْدُ حُرٌّ مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ.
verses.kjv: The small and great are there; and the servant [is] free from his master.
verses.web: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

verses.ar: «لِمَ يُعْطَى لِشَقِيٍّ نُورٌ، وَحَيَاةٌ لِمُرِّي ٱلنَّفْسِ؟
verses.kjv: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter [in] soul;
verses.web: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَنْتَظِرُونَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَلَيْسَ هُوَ، وَيَحْفُرُونَ عَلَيْهِ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ ٱلْكُنُوزِ،
verses.kjv: Which long for death, but it [cometh] not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
verses.web: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

verses.ar: ٱلْمَسْرُورِينَ إِلَى أَنْ يَبْتَهِجُوا، ٱلْفَرِحِينَ عِنْدَمَا يَجِدُونَ قَبْرًا!
verses.kjv: Which rejoice exceedingly, [and] are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.web: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

verses.ar: لِرَجُلٍ قَدْ خَفِيَ عَلَيْهِ طَرِيقُهُ، وَقَدْ سَيَّجَ ٱللهُ حَوْلَهُ.
verses.kjv: [Why is light given] to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?
verses.web: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مِثْلَ خُبْزِي يَأْتِي أَنِينِي، وَمِثْلَ ٱلْمِيَاهِ تَنْسَكِبُ زَفْرَتِي،
verses.kjv: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
verses.web: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي ٱرْتِعَابًا ٱرْتَعَبْتُ فَأَتَانِي، وَٱلَّذِي فَزِعْتُ مِنْهُ جَاءَ عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
verses.web: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

verses.ar: لَمْ أَطْمَئِنَّ وَلَمْ أَسْكُنْ وَلَمْ أَسْتَرِحْ، وَقَدْ جَاءَ ٱلرُّجْزُ».
verses.kjv: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
verses.web: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”
